title: Settlement Bureau Basis: the Client Discount Booked for a Kiosk Trip Rung Without It
content:
Where a kiosk shopping trip at an Unattended Micro Market Program market was rung without the client discount the till should have met, the discount is booked to the agreement afterwards as a drawdown against the client's funding.

## The calculation

The trip is valued from the agreement's own drawdown record, that value is grossed back to a shelf figure at the share of shelf price printed against the market format, the share that applies to the trip is applied to that shelf figure, and the discount so obtained is held to the daily ceiling printed against the market format.

The trip is valued at the most recent drawdown posted against the agreement. The mean drawdown is taken over the three months to the day the discount is worked out, being the total of the drawdowns posted in that window divided by the number of them. The share that applies to the trip is the share of shelf price printed against the market format. Nothing is added to or taken off that share on account of how the client has funded the market.

The shelf figure, the discount so obtained and the discount booked are each rounded to the nearest cent as they are taken, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent. The share that applies to the trip is taken to the nearest hundredth of a percentage point.

Where the market format's subsidy model meets no share of shelf price, no shelf figure is recovered and no discount is booked at all.

## A figure worked through

*Hypothetical inputs.* The most recent drawdown posted against the agreement stands at 1.84 USD. The market format meets a share of shelf price of 20 per cent and prints a daily ceiling of 5.50 USD for one employee on one day.

The trip is valued at 1.84 USD. Grossed back at the printed share of shelf price of 20 per cent, the shelf figure is 9.20 USD. The share that applies to the trip is that same printed share of 20 per cent, which taken of 9.20 USD gives a discount of 1.84 USD. Held to the daily ceiling of 5.50 USD, the discount booked is 1.84 USD.

*Hypothetical inputs, second case.* The most recent drawdown stands at 6.10 USD on a format meeting a share of shelf price of 30 per cent with a daily ceiling of 5.50 USD. The shelf figure is 20.33 USD, the share applied gives 6.10 USD, and the ceiling of 5.50 USD governs, so 5.50 USD is booked.

*Hypothetical inputs, third case.* The market format meets no share of shelf price. No shelf figure is recovered and no discount is booked at all.
